Implement weekly repo-review smart-cron (bd-m7ac): built-in weekly-review workflow (scout-fanout -> oracle-synthesize -> br-create ONE bead, tagged weekly-review+date) + smart-cron wiring (cron add weekly-review --cron "0 4 * * 0" --owner oracle --mode headless --template weekly-review).

Plan: (1) study builtin_workflows.rs + headless runner + cron add/tick path, (2) implement scout-fanout (parallel headless map toron+flywheel internal gaps + upstream parity agent-mail/buzz), (3) oracle-synthesize (glm-5.2 high effort -> single best idea), (4) br create one bead (skip honest if nothing), (5) gate: cron add + simulated tick + exactly-one-bead, (6) tests TDD + close. Locks: flywheel/src, workflows/, state, .beads.
